The fixes-and-honesty release: the loop watches your tests now, the wifi probe asks first, and nothing fetches twice for one word of weather.

**The loop watches your tests**
- **Failing-test transitions** — the PostToolUse refinement now reads test-runner output (npm/yarn/pnpm/bun test, node --test, jest, vitest, mocha, pytest, go test, cargo test) and speaks exactly twice: once when the suite starts failing ("read the cadence as debug"), once when it recovers. Tri-state honest: a run whose output can't be parsed keeps the previous observation — it can never mask a failing suite. Priority when several events fire: conflict > tests > thrash.

**Consent, consistently**
- **wifi SSID is now opt-in** (`cadence enable wifi`) — it names your location, so it follows the same consent rule as typing tempo, focused app, and esoteric. When off, the probe doesn't even spawn. The signals view explains every state, including the macOS Location Services caveat.
- MusicBrainz remains the one deliberate exception (zero-config music is the point; artist-name-only, keyless, cached forever) — now documented as such.

**Less waste, more honesty**
- **Weather is cached** (30 min, location-keyed in `~/.cadence/weather-cache.json`) — the prompt and stop hooks no longer make two Open-Meteo round-trips per turn for one word
- **`cadence report` tells the truth** — the no-args view applies the same 2h TTL the hook does, shows time remaining, and distinguishes "(last self-report expired)" from "(no self-report set)"

76 tests, 0 failures.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cullumco/cadence
